Name: AiDialogue
Author: gaoqiao123
Description:
AI Dialogue adds dynamic AI-powered conversations to Stardew Valley while preserving the visual style of the original game.

NPCs can greet the farmer with newly generated dialogue, respond to typed messages, react to accepted gifts and talk to other nearby NPCs. Dialogue is displayed through Stardew Valley's native dialogue box and portrait system.

MAIN FEATURES

• Dynamic farmer and NPC conversations
NPCs generate their first line through the selected AI model. Click the Reply button beneath the normal dialogue box to type your response.

• Individual NPC personalities
Each NPC uses current game facts and can have a separate custom persona. Custom personas can apply to one save or all saves.

• Isolated NPC memories
Permanent memories belong only to the selected NPC and are never automatically shared with other characters. Memories support importance values from 0.0 to 1.0.

• Automatic NPC-to-NPC conversations
Nearby eligible NPCs can form independent conversation pairs. Each round contains 2–5 alternating lines. Both participants are reserved until the conversation ends, while other free NPCs can start separate conversations.

• Scheduled activity support
NPCs can use AI dialogue while performing ordinary activities. This includes scenes such as Sam playing pool, practicing guitar or working. Activities with important game effects retain their original behavior.

• Context-aware dialogue
Requests include the current NPC and farmer names, location, date, time, weather, relationship, current activity, nearby characters and recent relevant conversation.

• Portrait expressions
Compatible vision-capable models can classify the NPC's actual portrait frames into supported emotional labels. Generated replies can display the matching native portrait expression.

• Optional dialogue friendship
Player replies can change friendship according to the NPC's personality, background and conversation context. Ordinary changes are limited to -5 through +5. Serious offenses may cause a larger loss. Friendship changes are shown in a custom notification panel.

• Gift reactions
Accepted ordinary gifts can receive generated AI dialogue. Item handling, birthdays, gift taste and normal game effects are still controlled by Stardew Valley.

• Conversation compression
Conversation history is summarized every 15 in-game days by default, preserving important facts, experiences, promises and unresolved topics while limiting context size.

• English and Simplified Chinese
The interface, generated instructions and documentation support English and Simplified Chinese. Player-written personas, memories and existing conversations are preserved exactly as written.

SUPPORTED API PROVIDERS

• DeepSeek
• SiliconFlow
• OpenAI
• OpenRouter
• Anthropic / Claude
• Groq

The player selects a provider and enters their own API key. Available models are loaded automatically. No API URL or model identifier needs to be typed manually.

INSTALLATION

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download and extract the archive.
3. Place the AiDialogue folder inside the Stardew Valley Mods folder.
4. Confirm that Mods/AiDialogue/manifest.json exists.
5. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
6. Load a save and open Esc > Options > AI Dialogue Settings.
7. Select your API provider and enter your complete API key.
8. Select one of the detected models.
9. Enable AI Dialogue and save the settings.

NPC conversations and dialogue friendship are separate optional settings.

REQUIREMENTS

• Stardew Valley 1.6.15
• SMAPI 4.5.2 or later
• Your own supported API key
• A compatible conversation model
• An image-capable model if portrait classification is required

The current release has been verified on Windows. Other operating systems have not yet been fully tested.

MULTIPLAYER

The mod currently operates in single-player and on the host's current view. NPC speech bubbles are not synchronized to remote multiplayer clients.

PRIVACY

The mod has no author telemetry or callback server.

Relevant dialogue, selected memories and game context are sent only to the AI provider selected by the user. Portrait classification sends the current NPC portrait contact sheet to that provider.

API keys are stored locally in the mod's config.json file without encryption. Do not share a used mod folder containing your personal configuration or save data.

The public download contains a blank configuration and does not contain the author's API key, personal memories, player identity, save data or conversation history.

UPDATING

Exit the game completely before updating. Replace the runtime and documentation files while preserving your existing config.json, assets/npcs edits and data folder.
